approval_note: approved=true satisfies the bounded worker input contract for operator-created synthetic fixtures; it does not represent independent human review.
design_basis: Designed after observing baseline format-conflict and support-boundary failures.
limits: This reuses the exact twenty evaluation questions after inspecting baseline errors.
This is an adaptive diagnostic, not a fresh unseen test or a general accuracy estimate.
Reference facts are shared with training; no exact normalized held-out question is trained.
Labels are computed from the explicit fictional policies; no model-generated labels are used.
Five questions per group and one seed do not establish production quality.
